text:
alex: Planning to lift feature flag `routing_v3` for EU tenants tomorrow 2026-03-30 09:00 UTC. Who's on deploy and smoke?

sophia: I can take deploy. Ops on-call during that window is Derek — @derek can you ack?

derek: Ack. I'll be the rollback custodian. Ping me 10m before flip.

alex: TL;DR plan: 09:00 flip 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~20m with 5m observation at each step. Smoke checklist: 1) quick latency healthcheck 2) token-cost sanity 3) 5xx/4xx error rate watch 4) per-tenant routing sanity and fallback.

alex: Smoke commands (run at each step):
```bash
# smoke: simple gen to canary
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST' https://api.redwood.internal/v1/gen?model=small -d '{"prompt":"healthcheck"}'
# perf: loadgen 50qps 120s
# metrics: check /dash/metrics?filter=routing_v3,errors,latency
```

sophia: I'll run smoke 0/1/2 checks and post results. Also updated safe default: on fail we keep fallback to `route_v2` + response-normalizer v1 (no model swap).

chris: QA note: ensure prefix-cache warmup is enabled for the EU pool, otherwise cold-starts inflate latency. @liz can you confirm warmup scheduled at 08:45 UTC?

liz: Confirmed. Warmup job scheduled for 2026-03-30 08:45 UTC targeting EU pool nodes (script: jobs/warmup/eu_prefix_warmup).

rachel: Rollback readiness: I have a terraform revert PR ready to flip the flag back to `off` and a circuit-breaker preset to 0.3. Rollback steps in ops runbook include: 1) flip flag off 2) route affected tenants to dedicated fallback pool 3) revert grpc-routing rules if needed. Runbook link below.

alex: Runbook: https://confluence.internal/redeploys/routing_v3_runbook — please review before window. Abort/rollback triggers: sustained CPU > 80% across EU pool, error rate > 0.5% for 5m, or token-cost > baseline+30%.

sophia: I'll post short status pings in #eng-platform during the flip. @deploy-bot please create a deployment marker and tag the runbook.

deploy-bot: Deployment marker created: routing_v3_flip_3543210987 by sophia at 09:00 UTC

derek: I'm available 08:30-10:30 UTC. If I miss a ping >5m during the flip assume automated rollback and reopen the thread.

sophia: Thanks team — will post preflight at 08:40 with warmup success and then start 09:00. :thumbsup:
